props.name: aria-label
props.description: The input's name when there is no `label`. The steppers' names then end with it too, as in "Increase Quantity".

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focuses the input when the field mounts, but not when a form reset remounts it.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the field's root.

props.name: decreaseLabel
props.description: The decrease stepper's own word, which its name follows with the field's name, as in "Decrease Quantity". It defaults to the locale's word.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting value of an uncontrolled field.

props.name: denomination
props.description: A unit shown between the input and the steppers, such as `kWh`. It is not part of the input's name or value, so say the unit in `label` or `description` too.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text, rendered as `Field.Description`.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: The error message, rendered as `Field.Error` while it is truthy. Pass `isInvalid` with it, so the input is marked invalid too. Without it, the field shows its own error, such as the browser's constraint message.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: How the value is shown and announced, as `Intl.NumberFormatOptions`, such as `{ style: "currency", currency: "NOK" }`. The locale, and with it the grouping and decimal separators, comes from the `LocaleProvider`.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of Base UI's `NumberField.Root`.

props.name: increaseLabel
props.description: The increase stepper's own word, which its name follows with the field's name, as in "Increase Quantity". It defaults to the locale's word.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the field, with the muted fill.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid, with the invalid look on the field box.

props.name: isPending
props.description: Shows a spinner at the end of the label row. The row shows even without `label`.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Makes the field read-only, with the muted fill.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Makes the field required, so the browser's constraint check blocks an empty submit.

props.name: isSuccess
props.description: Shows a check at the end of the label row, in place of the `isPending` spinner. The row shows even without `label`.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label, rendered as `Field.Label`. Without it, name the field with `aria-label`.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: The highest value the field takes.

props.name: minValue
props.description: The lowest value the field takes.

props.name: name
props.description: The name the field submits its number under.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the number on every change, each typed character included. A cleared input reports `NaN`. To act once per change, such as to save or fetch, use `onValueCommitted`.

props.name: onValueCommitted
props.description: Called once with the number when the user finishes a change: when the input blurs after typing, when a stepper press ends, and on each arrow, Home or End key press. It does not fire on each typed character, and Enter does not commit. A cleared input reports `NaN`. Save or fetch from it.

props.name: size
props.description: The control size of the field box around the input and the steppers, also written as `data-size`. `default` is the md control size, and `sm` the sm one. The steppers fill the box's height at both sizes.

props.name: step
props.description: How far the arrow keys and steppers move the value. Left out, they step by 1 and a typed value is held to no step grid. With `minValue`, a typed value must also land on the step grid counted from `minValue`, or native validation blocks the submit, as with `<input type="number" min step>`. Pass `step={1}` to accept whole numbers only. Without `minValue`, a step never limits a typed value.

props.name: value
props.description: The value, for a controlled field. `NaN` is an empty controlled field. `undefined`, passed or left out, makes the field uncontrolled, as with React's own inputs.
